tableLines.text: ◈ THE MENTOR — Liam watches Skylar work, then reaches over. "No. Like this." An hour later something has unlocked that no manual could teach. (Ability slots: 3)
◈ NEURAL CREEP — the overlay isn't on the world anymore. It's under it. Behind your eyes, faintly, when you blink.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+6 integration)

◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from Emberhold bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Feared. The show's narration lingers on your hands.

◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Fully identify 3 plants (knowledge level 3) within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesso
◈ HAVEN — You've noticed: people cover for each other without being asked. The gaps close themselves.
◈ CRISIS — THE BREACH. It got INSIDE. The haven was supposed to be the safe place — the one place. It isn’t.
◈ CRISIS — THE SIEGE. They came in the night for the pantry — and the village met them at the door with blades and fire and drove them back into the dark. Wealth has a scent. So does defiance.

◈ The Records: the Bearer won a contest under the cameras. The village's glory, public and loud.
◈ THE TRIAL — the audience is restless. The System offers Liam a trial, broadcast live. Survive it and take the slot. Refuse it and... well. The audience remembers refusals. (Ability slots: 4)

◈ CRISIS — THE HUNGER WINTER. Three days now the village has gone to sleep hungry. The pantry is an echo. This is the part the old stories skip — the part where you find out what you’re made of.
◈ LEVEL UP — FIELD 1. "We've been counting: 18 days worked on the land. Pick one."

Empty. You used to read the nutrition label when you missed numbers — calories, protein, the math of staying alive. Funny, the math that matters now.
◈ THE CREEP — Liam's thoughts have an echo now. The System's echo. Or theirs. Hard to tell anymore. Gifts used in sequence resonate — try them together. (Ability slots: 5)
